cards.front: Write I would like to help in French.
Write I prefer reading because it is relaxing in French.
back: Je préfère lire parce que c'est relaxant.

cards.front: Write Yesterday, I visited a town in French.
Write Tomorrow, I am going to work in French.
Correct: Mes amis est gentil.
back: The subject, verb and adjective must agree.

cards.front: Correct: Elle est allé en France.
back: The past participle agrees with the feminine subject after être.

cards.front: Translate into French: I have no brothers.
What should a writing plan record for each compulsory bullet?
back: A direct answer and relevant development, such as a reason, example or detail. Identify any requested time frame too.

cards.front: Why is a relative clause useful in un parc où je retrouve mes amis?
back: It adds a relevant detail about the park and connects the place to what happens there.

cards.front: Give the mark split for the 90-word task.
Translate into French: I have lived here for three years, and I like my town.
back: J'habite ici depuis trois ans et j'aime ma ville.
Present + depuis describes the continuing situation.

cards.front: Translate into French: Last weekend, I went to Paris with my sister.
back: Le week-end dernier, je suis allé / allée à Paris avec ma sœur.
Use être and the speaker's agreement; Paris takes à.

cards.front: Develop J'aime le sport with a reason and a particular activity.
back: J'aime le sport parce que cela me détend. Je joue au tennis avec mes amis le samedi.
The reason explains the preference; the activity, company and time provide specific detail.

cards.front: Explain the difference between je travaillerai, je vais travailler and je travaillerais.
back: Je travaillerai: I will work, simple future.
Je vais travailler: I am going to work, near future.
Je travaillerais: I would work, conditional.

cards.front: Correct: Hier, je vais au parc. J'aime joue. Ma sœur est allé. Il y a beaucoup des magasins.
back: Hier, **je suis allé / allée** au parc.

cards.front: Develop a view of your town in French with a reason, drawback and proposed improvement.
back: J'aime ma ville parce qu'elle est calme. Cependant, il n'y a pas assez de bus. Je voudrais améliorer les transports en commun pour aider les habitants.
The improvement directly addresses the stated problem. Pour + infinitive explains its purpose.
